posts.hook: Single-source dependency is rising. Visibility into supplier challenges is not.
posts.key_stat: Domestic single or sole-source supplier loss up 7%, international up 11%. 37% call single or sole-source suppliers a pressing vulnerability.
posts.visual_direction: Clean stat card contrasting the 7% domestic and 11% international loss figures, framing onboarding as the point where a structured supplier record is created.
